_what: Fingerprint of the sealed data at freeze. Lets anyone check later that the holdout scored is the holdout sealed, and that nobody edited a historical result in between. Computed by the auditor role with one SQL statement (below); the per-fight outcomes were hashed inside the database and never printed.
eligibility: fights with both fighters set, winner_id equal to one of them (draws and no-contests excluded), is_active IS DISTINCT FROM false (dead bookings excluded), event_date < 2026-10-12. 'priced' additionally requires a BestFightOdds closing-consensus quote (odds_books.name ILIKE 'BFO%', is_closer) on BOTH fighters. Amendment 1 (2026-10-13) also excludes fights 43, 46 and 8780, rebooked in place: their stored prices may belong to a different matchup.

hash_recipe.ids: sha256(string_agg(fight_id::text, ',' ORDER BY fight_id)) over priced eligible fights
hash_recipe.outcomes: sha256(string_agg(fight_id || ':' || (winner_id = fighter_a_id)::int, ',' ORDER BY fight_id)) over the same rows
hash_recipe.prices: sha256(string_agg(fight_id || ':' || american_a || ':' || american_b, ',' ORDER BY fight_id))
hash_recipe.events: sha256(string_agg(fight_id || ':' || event_id, ',' ORDER BY fight_id)) - fixes which card each fight is resampled with

superseded_v1_0.why: included three rebooked-in-place fights; superseded before any look

RESERVE.note: no BFO closing consensus exists after 2026-07-11; sealed and unscored

known_contamination: H1 is not virgin. The v4, v5 and v6 models and the engine's last walk-forward folds were scored on 2025-2026 fights, and the results (the market won) are published. Anyone who has read them knows how a typical model does there.

The Factor Lab (factor-rates.json) computes its market-controlled verdicts over ALL years including H1. Any experiment whose features were chosen because a Factor Lab verdict looked good (age, UFC record) has selected on H1. Such an experiment must declare it, and its H1 result is recorded as non-confirmatory: it may go to a prospective test but cannot count as historical evidence.
The engine (engine_v1/v2) was trained with data through 2026-07, so it is not eligible for an H1 evaluation at all.

The incumbent engine's walk-forward folds and its market blend already span 2020-2026, so the engine has, in effect, seen H1 and cannot be first-opened on it (noted by INFO-AUDIT-001, recorded in D-022).
recipe: research/protocol/holdout_manifest.sql (the exact statement; re-run it to check every H1 hash)
h1_fight_ids_file: research/protocol/h1_fight_ids.txt (ids only, comma-separated, ascending; no outcomes)
mutable_inputs: fight_odds is not yet append-only (proposed_2026-09-16_fight_odds_immutability.sql is unapplied) and is_closer can be promoted or demoted by fetch-odds.js. The prices hash makes any change to an H1 benchmark price visible; it does not prevent one.
fights.is_active and fights.winner_id can change (booking retired, result corrected). The ids and outcomes hashes make that visible.
